summary: Reads three 16-bit fields of the receiver (offsets 0x188, 0x18A, 0x18C) and stores each into a caller-provided output pointer, writing only when that pointer is non-null. Returns the fourth argument pointer regardless of null.

local_names.this: receiver whose 16-bit fields are read (__int16 pointer)
local_names.a2: first output pointer, receives field 0x18C when non-null
local_names.a3: second output pointer, receives field 0x18A when non-null
local_names.a4: third output pointer, receives field 0x188 when non-null; also the return value
local_names.result: alias of a4 carried through the tail write

operations.description: Write to *a2 is blocked when a2 is NULL
When a2 is non-null, store the 16-bit value at this+0x18C into *a2
When a3 is non-null, store the 16-bit value at this+0x18A into *a3
Write to *a4 is blocked when a4 is NULL; result is set to a4 before the check
When a4 is non-null, store the 16-bit value at this+0x188 into *a4
Return a4 (the fourth argument) whether or not the write took place

unresolved: The semantic meaning of the three 16-bit fields (0x188, 0x18A, 0x18C) as UI position components comes from the existing-analysis fill and is not independently grounded in this packet.
